title: Universal property of the sheaf balancing morphism
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $B,C$ sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], $\varphi:B\to C$ an algebra morphism, and $P$ a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_0$ for scalar restriction to $\mathcal O_Y$, $B_0,C_0$ for the underlying modules, $S=C_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}P_0$, $F=B_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}S$, and $T=(C\otimes_B P)|_{\mathcal O_Y}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $\tau$ for the canonical pure tensor sections and $\eta$ for the sectionwise change-of-rings sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For any $\mathcal O_Y$-linear morphisms $a,d:F\to S$ and $g:S\to T$ with the section formulas $a_W(\tau(b,\tau(c,p)))=\tau(c,bp)$, $d_W(\tau(b,\tau(c,p)))=\tau(\varphi_W(b)c,p)$ and $g_W(\tau(c,p))=\eta_W(c\otimes_Bp)$, every $\mathcal O_Y$-module sheaf $Q$ and morphism $f:S\to Q$ satisfying $a\circ f=d\circ f$ admit a unique $\mathcal O_Y$-linear $t:T\to Q$ with $g\circ t=f$. Composition is in diagrammatic order; no $C$-action on $Q$ or quasi-coherence assumption is required.

proof.text: Precompose f with the tensor sheafification unit. Evaluating a followed by f = d followed by f on the stated pure tensors gives h(c,bp)=h(phi(b)c,p). Thus on every open the bilinear h factors through C tensor_B P by its balanced tensor universal property as an O-linear map. Pure tensor generation verifies compatibility with restrictions.

The C-module sheafification of the presheaf C tensor_B P restricts to its O-module sheafification: both have the same associated additive sheaf, and their O-actions agree on the unit and hence uniquely on the sheafification. Extend the factored presheaf morphism to t:T->Q. The formula for g identifies g followed by t with f after the tensor unit, hence everywhere by sheafification uniqueness.

Any second t with the same factorization agrees after the change-of-rings presheaf unit on all c tensor_B p by the formula for g. Pure tensors generate sectionwise, so the presheaf maps agree. Uniqueness of O-module sheafification implies equality of t.

theorem changeOfRings_tensor_balancing_universal (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    let P₀ := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P
    let S := tensorObj C.toModule P₀
    let T := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
      (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P)
    ∀ (a d : tensorObj B.toModule S ⟶ S) (g : S ⟶ T),
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        a.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c (b • p)) →
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        d.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p) →
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        g.app W (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p) =
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 C.right).obj)).unit.app
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ.right P)).app (op W))
              (c ⊗ₜ[B.right.obj.obj (op W), (φ.right.hom.app (op W)).hom] p)) →
      ∀ (Q : Y.Modules) (f : S ⟶ Q), a ≫ f = d ≫ f →
        ∃! t : T ⟶ Q, g ≫ t = f
